source.title: Sussex Woodland & Meadow Bird Sounds, Evening.MP3
source.author: Vonora
source.notes: 32 kHz mono MP3, 145 s: English woodland birds (1.5-4 kHz) toward evening, getting busier and louder as it goes; an airplane's rumble (under 300 Hz) from about 42 s, which the steep 400 Hz high-pass takes; something sharp at 129 s and a click at the end. The loop is the steadiest stretch, so its two ends meet at about the same level.
